children.name: Elasticsearch - Garbage Collection
children.description: The Elasticsearch - Garbage Collector dashboard provides information on the garbage collection of the Java Virtual Machine.
children.title: Elasticsearch - Garbage Collection

queries.queryString:
db_cluster=* db_system=elasticsearch db_cluster={{db_cluster}} "Pre Evacuate Collection Set" or "Merge Heap Roots" or "Evacuate Collection Set" or "Post Evacuate Collection Set" or "Other" | json "log" as rawlog nodrop
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), raw, rawlog) as raw 
| parse regex "\[(?<date>[^\]]+)\]\[(?<process_id>[^\]]+)\]\[(?<module>[^\]]+)\]\s+GC\(.*\)(?<Time_Name>.*):\s+(?<pre_collect_set>\d+\.\d+)ms"
| timeslice by 1h 
| if (isEmpty(pod),_sourceHost,pod) as host
| count(process_id) as Total_Process_Id group by Time_Name

db_cluster=* db_system=elasticsearch db_cluster={{db_cluster}} "Pre Evacuate Collection Set" or "Merge Heap Roots" or "Evacuate Collection Set" or "Post Evacuate Collection Set" or "Other" | json "log" as rawlog nodrop
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), raw, rawlog) as raw
| parse regex "\[(?<date>[^\]]+)\]\[(?<process_id>[^\]]+)\]\[(?<module>[^\]]+)\]\s+GC\(.*\)(?<Time_Name>.*):\s+(?<pre_collect_set>\d+\.\d+)ms"
| timeslice by 1h 
| if (isEmpty(pod),_sourceHost,pod) as host
| sum(pre_collect_set) as Total_Pre_Collect group by Time_Name

db_cluster=* db_system=elasticsearch db_cluster={{db_cluster}} "Pre Evacuate Collection Set" or "Merge Heap Roots" or "Evacuate Collection Set" or "Post Evacuate Collection Set" or "Other" | json "log" as rawlog nodrop
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), raw, rawlog) as raw 
| parse regex "\[(?<date>[^\]]+)\]\[(?<process_id>[^\]]+)\]\[(?<module>[^\]]+)\]\s+GC\(.*\)(?<Time_Name>.*):\s+(?<pre_collect_set>\d+\.\d+)ms"
| timeslice by 1h 
| if (isEmpty(pod),_sourceHost,pod) as host
| avg(pre_collect_set) as Avg_Pre_Collect group by Time_Name

db_cluster=* db_system=elasticsearch db_cluster={{db_cluster}} | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as mesg
| parse regex field=mesg "\[(?<date>[^\]]+)\]\[(?<process_id>[^\]]+)\]\[(?<module>[^\]]+)\].*(?<HeapBfrGC>\d+)M->(?<HeapAftrGC>\d+)M\((?<HeapSize>\d+)M\)\s+(?<GCOperationTime>[\d.]+)ms"
| timeslice 15m
| sum(GCOperationTime) as GCOperationTime by _timeslice

panels.title: GC - User Time

queries.queryString:
db_cluster=* db_system=elasticsearch db_cluster={{db_cluster}} | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as _raw
| parse regex "\[(?<date>[^\]]+)\]\[(?<process_id>[^\]]+)\]\[(?<module>[^\]]+)\]\s+GC\(.*\)\s*User=(?<user_time>\d+.\d+)s\s+Sys=(?<sys_time>\d+\.\d+)s\s+Real=(?<real_time>\d+.\d+)"
| avg(user_time) as Avg_User_Time, avg(sys_time) as Avg_Sys_Time, avg(real_time) as  Avg_Real_Time
| fields Avg_User_Time

panels.description: user: The CPU time that was spent on non-kernel (user-mode) code only within the given process — so other processes and the time when our process is blocked are not included.

queries.queryString:
db_cluster=* db_system=elasticsearch db_cluster={{db_cluster}} "Pre Evacuate Collection Set" or "Merge Heap Roots" or "Evacuate Collection Set" or "Post Evacuate Collection Set" or "Other" | json "log" as rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), raw, rawlog) as raw 
| parse regex "\[(?<date>[^\]]+)\]\[(?<process_id>[^\]]+)\]\[(?<module>[^\]]+)\]\s+GC\(.*\)(?<time_name>.*):\s+(?<pre_collect_set>\d+\.\d+)ms"
| timeslice by 1h 
| if (isEmpty(pod),_sourceHost,pod) as host
| max(pre_collect_set) as Max_Time group by time_name

db_cluster=* db_system=elasticsearch db_cluster={{db_cluster}} "Pre Evacuate Collection Set" or "Merge Heap Roots" or "Evacuate Collection Set" or "Post Evacuate Collection Set" or "Other" | json "log" as rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), raw, rawlog) as raw 
| parse regex "\[(?<date>[^\]]+)\]\[(?<process_id>[^\]]+)\]\[(?<module>[^\]]+)\]\s+GC\(.*\)(?<time_name>.*):\s+(?<pre_collect_set>\d+\.\d+)ms"
| timeslice by 1h 
| if (isEmpty(pod),_sourceHost,pod) as host
| min(pre_collect_set) as Min_Time group by time_name

db_cluster=* db_system=elasticsearch db_cluster={{db_cluster}} | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as mesg
| parse regex field=mesg "\[(?<date>[^\]]+)\]\[(?<process_id>[^\]]+)\]\[(?<module>[^\]]+)\].*(?<HeapBfrGC>\d+)M->(?<HeapAftrGC>\d+)M\((?<HeapSize>\d+)M\)\s+(?<GCOperationTime>[\d.]+)ms"
| timeslice 15m
| avg(HeapBfrGC) as BeforeGC, avg(HeapAftrGC) as AfterGC by _timeslice

db_cluster=* db_system=elasticsearch db_cluster={{db_cluster}} | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as mesg
| parse regex "\[(?<date>[^\]]+)\]\[(?<process_id>[^\]]+)\]\[(?<module>[^\]]+)\].*(?<Usage_Heap>\s\d+)M->(?<Feed_memory>\d+)M\((?<total_heap>\d+)M\)\s(?<Total_Time>\d+.\d+)ms"
| number(Usage_Heap) as usage_heap1
| number(total_heap) as total_heap1
| (usage_heap1/total_heap1)*100 as Percent_Heap
| timeslice 1s
| count by _timeslice, Percent_Heap
| transpose row _timeslice column Percent_Heap

db_cluster=* db_system=elasticsearch db_cluster={{db_cluster}} | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as mesg
| parse regex field=mesg "\[(?<date>[^\]]+)\]\[(?<process_id>[^\]]+)\]\[(?<module>[^\]]+)\].*(?<HeapBfrGC>\d+)M->(?<HeapAftrGC>\d+)M\((?<HeapSize>\d+)M\)\s+(?<GCOperationTime>[\d.]+)ms"
| if (isEmpty(pod),_sourceHost,pod) as Host

db_cluster=* db_system=elasticsearch db_cluster={{db_cluster}} | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as mesg
| parse regex field=mesg "\[(?<date>[^\]]+)\]\[(?<process_id>[^\]]+)\]\[(?<module>[^\]]+)\].*\s+GC\((?<gc_id>\d+)\)\s+Pause\s+Young\s+\((?<Cause>[^\]]+)\)\s+(?<HeapBfrGC>\d+)M->(?<HeapAftrGC>\d+)M\((?<HeapSize>\d+)M\)\s+(?<GCOperationTime>[\d.]+)ms" nodrop

| sum(GCOperationTime) as GCOperationTime by Cause

db_cluster=* db_system=elasticsearch db_cluster={{db_cluster}} | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as mesg
| parse regex field=mesg "\[(?<date>[^\]]+)\]\[(?<process_id>[^\]]+)\]\[(?<module>[^\]]+)\].*\s+GC\((?<gc_id>\d+)\)\s+Pause\s+Young\s+\((?<Cause>[^\]]+)\)\s+(?<HeapBfrGC>\d+)M->(?<HeapAftrGC>\d+)M\((?<HeapSize>\d+)M\)\s+(?<GCOperationTime>[\d.]+)ms" nodrop

| sum(GCOperationTime) as Total_Time, avg(GCOperationTime) as Avg_Time, max(GCOperationTime) as Max_Time, count as Count by Cause

db_cluster=* db_system=elasticsearch db_cluster=* | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop

children.name: Elasticsearch - Login And Connections
children.description: Elasticsearch - Login And Connections dashboard shows geo location of client connection requests, failed connection logins and count of failed login attempts
children.title: Elasticsearch - Login And Connections

queries.queryString:
db_cluster=* db_system=elasticsearch db_cluster={{db_cluster}} "failed to authenticate user" | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as _raw
| json field=_raw "timestamp" as timestamp
| json field=_raw "level" as level
| json field=_raw "component" as component
| json field=_raw "message" as message
| where  message matches "*failed to authenticate user*"
| count

| json field=_raw "component" as component

| where level = "INFO" and message matches "*failed to authenticate user*"
| parse regex field=message "failed to authenticate user \[(?<user>[\S]+)\]"
| if (isEmpty(pod),_sourceHost,pod) as host
| count by host,user
| order by _count
